ns2:course.label: Viewing Dance
ns2:course.description: Overview of contemporary dance from around the globe, focusing on the current works of significant emerging and established choreographers working in the field today. May be repeated to a maximum of 3 hours. Prerequisite: Restricted to Dance majors and minors.
